message.content:
Fix these issues in the Zip Code Checker app at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code:

## Issue 1: syncConfigMetafield called on every page load
File: app/routes/app.widget.tsx

The `syncConfigMetafield()` function is being called inside the `loader`. This means every time a merchant visits the widget config page, it makes 2 GraphQL API calls to Shopify even if nothing changed. Move the sync to ONLY happen in the `action` (on save/reset), NOT in the loader.

Read the file first, then:
- Remove `syncConfigMetafield()` call from the loader
- Ensure it stays in the action (on save)

## Issue 2: DEFAULTS object inside component
File: app/routes/app.widget.tsx

The DEFAULTS object is defined inside the component on every render. Move it outside the component to module scope so it's only created once. This also fixes the eslint-disable-next-line for react-hooks/exhaustive-deps.

## Issue 3: TypeScript type mismatch for customCss
File: app/routes/app.widget.tsx

The WidgetConfig type declares `customCss: string` but Prisma returns `String?` (nullable). Fix the type to match: `customCss: string | null`. Also check all usages are null-safe.

## Issue 4: Missing try/catch in app.zip-codes.tsx action
File: app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx

Read the action function. If database operations are not wrapped in try/catch, add proper error handling that catches errors and returns them via json().

Read both files first, understand the current code, then make minimal targeted fixes.

Confirmed — all four TypeScript errors are pre-existing issues in the component UI code (Polaris `Badge` inside `Button` children, and `Badge` children type mismatches). None are related to any of the four fixes I made, and none are in `app.widget.tsx`. The widget file is clean.

Here is a summary of every change made:

---

**Issue 1 — syncConfigMetafield removed from loader**

File: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/routes/app.widget.tsx`, lines 39-48 (original).

Root cause: The loader called `syncConfigMetafield(admin, configData)` unconditionally on every page visit, firing 2 GraphQL mutations to Shopify even when nothing had changed.

What changed: Removed the block that destructured `config` and called `syncConfigMetafield` from the loader. The `admin` variable was also no longer needed in the loader but it stays because `authenticate.admin(request)` is required regardless (auth-first rule). The function itself remains intact and is still called in the `save` and `reset` action branches.

**Issue 2 — DEFAULTS moved to module scope**

File: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/routes/app.widget.tsx`, before `buildWidgetCss`.

Root cause: `DEFAULTS` was declared inside `WidgetPage()`, so a new object was allocated on every render. It also forced the `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` suppression on `handleReset` because including `DEFAULTS` in the deps array would have re-created the callback on every render.

What changed: Moved `DEFAULTS` to module scope (between the `syncConfigMetafield` function and `buildWidgetCss`). Removed the inline declaration from the component body. Removed the `eslint-disable-next-line` comment from `handleReset` — the deps array `[fetcher, shopify]` is now correct with no suppression needed.

**Issue 3 — customCss type fixed to string | null**

File: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/routes/app.widget.tsx`, `WidgetConfig` type.

Root cause: Prisma schema declares `customCss String?` (nullable), but the local `WidgetConfig` type said `customCss: string`, creating a type mismatch whenever the DB value was `null`.

What changed: Changed `customCss: string` to `customCss: string | null` in the `WidgetConfig` type. All existing usages are already null-safe: `buildWidgetCss` uses `cfg.customCss ? cfg.customCss.replace(...) : ""` (line 278), the `customCss` state is initialized with `c.customCss || ""` so it is always a `string`, and `previewCfg` passes that `string` state value which satisfies `string | null`.

**Issue 4 — try/catch added to unguarded action intents**

File: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx`.

Root cause: The `delete`, `toggle`, `check`, and `export` intents had bare `await db.*` calls with no error handling — an unexpected Prisma error (e.g. record not found, DB connection drop) would have thrown an unhandled exception and crashed the action.

What changed: Wrapped each of the four intents in try/catch blocks that return `{ error: "..." }` on failure, matching the pattern already used by `add` and `update`. The `bulk-import` intent already had its own per-row try/catch inside the loop and was left unchanged.

To verify: Run `npm run dev`, open the widget config page, and confirm the server logs show zero GraphQL calls on page load (only the Prisma `findUnique`). Then save — the logs should show the two GraphQL calls. For the type fix, `npm run typecheck` shows no errors in `app.widget.tsx`.
